card.name: Linking words before chemotherapy drug names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, receiving, or, the and of, right before a cancer drug or regimen name (oxaliplatin, Vectibix, FOLFOX, cisplatin) in oncology label text.

modes.label: With/receiving before a drug
modes.description: The word 'with' or 'receiving' just before a named chemotherapy or antibody drug.
modes.example: These forms of neuropathy occurred in 48% of the study patients<< receiving>> oxaliplatin for injection with

modes.label: Combination wording
modes.description: 'in combination with' or 'or' linking one cancer drug to another.
modes.example: In 126 patients receiving Vectibix in combination<< with>> sotorasib across clinical studies,

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to continue with a specific drug or regimen name, though the promoted tokens are not clear.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a cancer drug name, such as 'treated with' or 'in combination with'.
